summary: T315 landed (commit a375801): scripts/eval-delta.sh's splice check now accepts the corpus-tail identity for the all-records carry-0 ring. The caller (not the awk) computes the last-12 record ids of .chug/decisions.jsonl (jq, '- '-prefixed, portable awk reversal — never tail -r/tac) only when the nothing-carried violation fires; an exact match with the state ring downgrades to 'ok (carried 0, rotated 0, appended N, corpus-tail-verified)' (an ok*-form the existing case accepts), while a mismatch, unreadable, or missing corpus keeps the violation verbatim (fail-closed). META-META-SPEC.md's ring-discipline paragraph gained the all-records exception rider. tests/eval_state_delta.rs gained the decisions_corpus fixture writer (T70 id-first shape) plus leg (a) — 26-record corpus, ring == tail-12 reversed, zero carried → STATE-HIT with the corpus-tail-verified ok-form — and leg (b) — one-id-off ring, missing corpus, and malformed corpus all keep the 'nothing carried verbatim' FULL-READ. RED-proofs ran pre-commit: leg (a) with the acceptance-leg case pattern stubbed → red (FULL-READ); leg (b) stays green under the stub.
